findings.title: No CSP relaxation for dev-mode eval
findings.desc: The policy has no `'unsafe-eval'` allowance for `script-src`, but Next.js's dev server (Fast Refresh / webpack or Turbopack eval-based module loading) requires `unsafe-eval` in development; without a NODE_ENV-based carve-out this CSP will break HMR/dev builds, which Next's own CSP docs call out explicitly.

findings.title: Root layout forces whole app to dynamic rendering
findings.desc: Calling `await headers()` unconditionally in `RootLayout` opts every route in the app out of static rendering/ISR, even pages that have no need for a per-request nonce, which can meaningfully increase server load/latency app-wide.

findings.title: x-nonce request header is set but never consumed
findings.desc: The proxy forwards `x-nonce` to server components via request headers, but no code (including the new `RootLayout`) reads it — the comment in the layout explicitly says it's unnecessary — leaving dead plumbing that may mislead future readers into thinking it's wired up for manual `<Script nonce>` usage.

findings.title: Prefetch exclusion may be stale
findings.desc: The matcher excludes prefetches via the `purpose: prefetch` header, but modern browsers/Next versions send `Sec-Purpose: prefetch`; if `purpose` is no longer sent, prefetch requests will consume/attach nonces unnecessarily, contradicting the stated intent of skipping prefetches.

FINDINGS:
1. proxy.ts:1-64 | Medium | correctness | No CSP relaxation for dev-mode eval | The policy has no `'unsafe-eval'` allowance for `script-src`, but Next.js's dev server (Fast Refresh / webpack or Turbopack eval-based module loading) requires `unsafe-eval` in development; without a NODE_ENV-based carve-out this CSP will break HMR/dev builds, which Next's own CSP docs call out explicitly.
2. app/layout.tsx:22-27 | Medium | performance | Root layout forces whole app to dynamic rendering | Calling `await headers()` unconditionally in `RootLayout` opts every route in the app out of static rendering/ISR, even pages that have no need for a per-request nonce, which can meaningfully increase server load/latency app-wide.
3. proxy.ts:36-41 | Low | maintainability | x-nonce request header is set but never consumed | The proxy forwards `x-nonce` to server components via request headers, but no code (including the new `RootLayout`) reads it — the comment in the layout explicitly says it's unnecessary — leaving dead plumbing that may mislead future readers into thinking it's wired up for manual `<Script nonce>` usage.
4. proxy.ts:58-63 | Low | correctness | Prefetch exclusion may be stale | The matcher excludes prefetches via the `purpose: prefetch` header, but modern browsers/Next versions send `Sec-Purpose: prefetch`; if `purpose` is no longer sent, prefetch requests will consume/attach nonces unnecessarily, contradicting the stated intent of skipping prefetches.
